name: callout
description: Callout box: icon + heading + text. Composition counterpart of the former text/callout block (its behavioural sibling text/alert stays a BLOCK — it has dismiss/variant logic).
provenPattern: Converted from a block to a composition under the rule 'arrangement-only → template'; the look was ported from the former block component.

knowledge.purpose: Callout box of icon, heading and text — draws attention inside the flow
useCases: Giving a warning or a tip inside a section
Stating the precondition of a step
antiPatterns: Using it for a dismissible/stateful alert — that is the text/alert block's job
Several callouts in one section — when all are emphasised, none is
Picking an icon unrelated to the text
